name: feishu-docs-publisher
description: Publish and sync Markdown notes, folders, and PDFs to Feishu/Lark Docs through the local lark-cli.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-embedded-helpers.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-embedded-helpers.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node test/test-link-rewrite.mjs && node test/test-pdf-links.mjs && node test/test-obsidian-export.mjs && node test/test-native-callout.mjs && node test/test-native-sync.mjs && node test/test-native-pre-push.mjs && node test/test-label-colors.mjs && node test/test-pdf-crops.mjs && node test/test-folder-path.mjs && node test/test-note-content.mjs && node test/test-lark-cli-command.mjs && node test/test-lark-cli-management.mjs && node test/test-lark-sync-core.mjs && node test/test-local-image.mjs && node test/test-svg-image.mjs && node test/test-image-gallery.mjs && node test/test-remote-cleanup.mjs && node test/test-ignore-rules.mjs && node test/test-sync-ignore.mjs && node test/test-main.mjs && node test/test-published-links.mjs && node test/test-pdf-publish.mjs && node test/test-pre-push.mjs
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
